summary: Record granted agent dismissal of denied harness calls and let senders withdraw their own informational updates

replay.detail: No historical claim rewriting. Source cancellation and denial answers remain durable claims; no synthetic Home tombstones.

schema.detail: Add optional acted_for/delegation fields to the harness.diagnostic claim schema. No SQL table, index or migration.

rules.detail: The existing close-item policy can dismiss a current auto-denial only, checked under the writer with agent actor, represented person, instruction, policy and episode. It cannot approve a call or kind; unproved agent native-prompt answers are refused.

compatibility.detail: Optional delegation proof and dismiss answer in prompt.respond clients; CLI alerts withdraw now accepts an informational update source or exact episode/card and returns its step disposition. Ordinary person answers omit the proof. Old readers/binaries and mixed-build acceptance need qualification.

downtime.detail: No deployment or restart is performed by this source change.

manual.detail: No policy is created or changed. A delegated caller supplies the actual existing person policy and verbatim prior instruction; missing authority is refused.

recovery.detail: Delegated denial close and its source notification commit together; source withdrawals preserve provenance and unrelated claims. No production/native mailbox recovery or original1894 acceptance follows.
